title: Relief on the Cancellation Charge Where the Member Trades Actively With the Cooperative
content:
The cancellation charge per gallon raised when gallons are released out of a booking on an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts is relieved for a member who takes their fuel here and carries their crop input business here. The gallons taken on the energy account and the credit department's standing decision on the member's Crop Input Purchasing Accounts decide the line.

1. Where the gallons taken on the account over the twelve months ending on the handling date reach the programme's minimum annual gallons and the credit department's standing decision on the member's crop input account is an approval, the cancellation charge per gallon is the programme's cancellation charge less 0.04 USD per gallon.
2. Where those gallons reach the programme's minimum annual gallons and that standing decision is not an approval, the cancellation charge per gallon is the programme's cancellation charge less 0.02 USD per gallon.
3. Where those gallons fall under the programme's minimum annual gallons, the cancellation charge per gallon is the programme's cancellation charge as the catalogue writes it.

## What is read

The gallons are the gallons delivered on the energy account over the twelve months ending on the handling date, measured against the yearly gallons figure the catalogue writes for the programme. The standing decision is the one the credit department has recorded against the member's Crop Input Purchasing Accounts, and is taken from that record rather than from anything the member says about their standing.

| Gallons taken in the window | The credit department's standing decision on the crop input account | Cancellation charge per gallon |
| --- | --- | --- |
| At or above the programme's minimum annual gallons | An approval | The programme's cancellation charge, less 0.04 |
| At or above the programme's minimum annual gallons | Anything other than an approval | The programme's cancellation charge, less 0.02 |
| Below the programme's minimum annual gallons | Either way | The programme's cancellation charge |

*Hypothetical.* On a programme whose cancellation charge is 0.15 USD per gallon and whose yearly gallons figure is 1000, an account that took 1200.0 gallons in the window, its holder carrying an approval on the crop input account, bears 0.11 USD per gallon. Without that approval it bears 0.13 USD per gallon. Had the account taken 900.0 gallons, it would bear the full 0.15 USD per gallon either way.
